variants.title: Calm reader
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final Spideryarn reading-spider identity candidate.
Image 1 is the preferred Z character: a faceless orange wool-cord knot-spider sitting cross-legged absorbed in a small dark open book. Preserve its quiet charm, material, hollow oval core and restraint. The user selected it and asks that it have EIGHT limbs like a spider.
Anatomy is the essential change. Exactly EIGHT separately traceable limbs: FOUR upper/rear free orange cord ends (two on each side, arranged as softly outward arcing upper and middle pairs); TWO lower/front curved orange cord arms supporting the book, their plain rounded ends visible at the book's edges; TWO orange cord legs crossed below the book, both rounded ends visible. Total 4+2+2=8. The central hollow oval body is not a limb. Separate the four free ends enough that all four count easily. No extra tail or ninth strand.
No eyes, face, eyebrows, mouth, literal fingers, hands, toes, shoes, clothes, motion marks or text. The pose and material suggest a likeable thoughtful reading companion. Deep reading, curiosity and connecting ideas; not a cartoon assistant.
A warm burnt-orange #DB8A45 wool cord, simple small charcoal hardcover book with ivory pages. One complete character centered on an opaque uniform warm ivory square, no environment, gentle studio shadow, generous 14 percent margins. Character must remain compact and clear as an app icon.
Specific variation: Closest to Z. Two long upper free ends rise diagonally and two shorter rear free ends arc more horizontally, one of each per side. Symmetrical crossed-loop base, softly held book. Fine restrained wool texture and balanced negative space.
